environment: SsoIntegrationTest with ephemeral MariaDB/Redis Testcontainers, packaged World nodes, synthetic test administrator UUID, and isolated recording SFU policy endpoints.

tests.name: participantReportCanBeReviewedAndKicksTheTargetAcrossWorldNodes
assertions: Reporter cannot access the administrator queue (403); only the configured synthetic administrator can review the report.
A reviewed participant report creates one WORLD_KICK action and closes the report with an audit history entry.
The target is removed from both World nodes and receives MODERATION_KICKED.
Repeating the same action request is idempotent and does not create another moderation action.

tests.name: participantMediaMutePropagatesFromAdminApiToWorldAndSfuPolicy
assertions: An administrator media-mute action updates the report, audit action, and persisted user restriction.
MICROPHONE, CAMERA, SCREEN, and SCREEN_AUDIO are removed in both active spaces on separate World nodes.
Both World policy epochs advance and both isolated SFU policy endpoints receive an empty allowed source set.
Repeating the same request remains idempotent.

remaining: An operator must provide the approved production SSO user UUID for TOWN_ADMIN_USER_IDS.
Verify the signed-in operator's access in the deployed environment and complete the browser moderation-console review.
Complete the production log-retention and privacy review before marking the moderation task done.
